prompt: Some people argue that offenders who have committed non-violent crimes should serve their sentences in the community rather than in prison. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In many countries the prisons are very crowded and the cost for the government is very high. Because of this, some people believe that the criminals who did not use the violence should do the community service instead of going to the prison. In my opinion, I agree with this idea, but not for all the cases.

Firstly, the prison is not a good place for a person who made a small crime. Inside the prison, he will meet the dangerous criminals and he can learn the bad things from them. After he comes out, it is very difficult to find a job because the companies do not want to employ the ex-prisoner. So he can do the crime again, and this is bad for the society.

Secondly, the community service is cheaper. The government spend a lot of money for every prisoner every year, and this money can be used for the schools or the hospitals. Also, when the offender is working in the community, for example cleaning the parks or helping the old people, he is giving something back to the people who he hurt.

However, some crimes like the big financial fraud are not violent but they destroy many lives. In this case, I think the prison is necessary, because the punishment must be serious.

In conclusion, I agree that most of the non-violent offenders should stay in the community, but the judge must look at every case separately, because some non-violent crimes are also very serious.
title: Community sentences instead of prison
